name: Ja'Marr Chase
note: Hyperextended knee in practice late Aug 2026; limited in practice week of 9/1 but Zac Taylor expects him for 9/13 opener vs Tampa Bay.

name: Puka Nacua
note: Psoas soreness from 8/11 joint practice cost ~3 weeks; returned to practice by 8/31 and trending toward Week 1, but reps still ramping and a possible league discipline matter (unrelated to injury) is unresolved as of 9/2.

name: Christian McCaffrey
note: Camp calf tightness/workload management resolved; back to full practice as of early Sept 2026, expected to start Week 1 vs Rams in Australia.

name: Ashton Jeanty
note: Ankle sprain since 8/23, still sidelined at practice 9/2; not on IR, HC Kubiak optimistic he plays 9/13 opener vs Dolphins but needs practice reps first.

name: Jeremiyah Love
note: Rookie RB, No. 3 overall pick to Arizona Cardinals in 2026 draft; no current injury concerns reported, minor college rib/knee history but played through both, missed zero games.

name: Malik Nabers
note: Recovering from 2025 torn ACL plus a second offseason scar-tissue procedure; cleared for full contact late Aug, HC Harbaugh calls Week 1 (9/13 vs Cowboys) 'reasonable' but Nabers himself is non-committal.

name: Breece Hall
note: Groin strain from late-Aug practice, originally given 2-3 week timeline; running without issues by late Aug/early Sept and expected ready for 9/13 opener vs Titans.

name: Zay Flowers
note: Quad/lower-body issue limiting camp practice reps; Ravens managing him cautiously, full expectation he plays Week 1 vs Colts per CBS Sports (early Sept).

name: Emeka Egbuka
note: Toe sprain suffered mid-Aug joint practice with Jets, confirmed stable sprain via specialist; missed practice 9/2, HC Bowles 'hopeful' for 9/13 opener vs Bengals but status uncertain.

name: Tee Higgins
note: Bruised/contused heel, limited and missed practice early Sept; Zac Taylor says not a major concern, both Higgins and Chase expected good for Week 1 vs Tampa Bay (9/13).

name: D'Andre Swift
note: Left practice early 9/3 with cramps (held midsection); early word is not serious, Bears prepping for 9/13 opener at Carolina.

name: Tyler Warren
note: Minor groin injury from joint practice with Falcons; returned to practice 9/1 and expected to play without restrictions Week 1 vs Ravens.

name: Bhayshul Tuten
note: Sent home from practice 9/2 with illness (not injury); Jaguars don't play until 9/13 vs Browns, expected to be fine by Week 1.

name: Rome Odunze
note: Right leg injury exiting practice 9/3 (some reports cite MCL sprain concern); early testing positive, expected to be 'all good' but enters Week 1 prep (9/13 vs Panthers) with a question mark.

name: George Kittle
note: Recovering from Jan 2026 Achilles tear; activated off PUP list, positive practice days, traveling to Australia for 9/10 opener vs Rams, but not yet officially cleared to play as of early Sept.

name: Sam LaPorta
note: Hip injury caused missed practices in camp; returned to practice (individual + team drills) by early Sept, no official Week 1 word yet vs Saints opener but trending positive; separate from resolved 2025 back-surgery issue.

name: Luther Burden III
note: Groin injury since 8/8 collision, missed all Bears preseason games; back at practice by late Aug/early Sept, HC Ben Johnson expects him to suit up for 9/13 opener vs Panthers.

name: TreVeyon Henderson
note: Ankle injury (slipped in practice 8/24/26), not yet full practice as of 9/4-9/5, expected 'good to go' for Week 1 vs Seahawks 9/9 but unconfirmed (Yahoo Sports/CLNS)

name: Carnell Tate
note: Rookie WR, Titans (NOT Bears) - missed practice 9/1 with 'stiffness' per coach Saleh; earlier preseason concussion; no indication Week 1 status is in danger (NBC Sports/RotoWire)

name: Josh Jacobs
note: Groin injury plus placed on NFL Commissioner's Exempt List 9/2-3/26 after criminal charges filed in Brown County WI; cannot practice or play while on list, Week 1 status unresolved (Yahoo Sports/Heavy)

name: Mike Evans
note: Returned to practice 9/2-3/26, over groin/quad/abductor injuries that limited him most of camp; team optimistic he plays Week 1 vs Rams 9/10 in Australia (SI/49ers Webzone)

name: DK Metcalf
note: Undisclosed injury for much of camp, returned to practice ~8/31, says he feels '100%', expected ready for Week 1 vs Falcons 9/13 (CBS Sports/FantasyPros)

name: Michael Pittman Jr.
note: Right-leg injury in camp, back on practice field last week (early Sept), expected available for Steelers Week 1 vs Falcons 9/13 (Bleacher Report)

name: Tucker Kraft
note: Returning from ACL tear suffered Week 9 2025; expected 'full go' for Week 1 vs Vikings but will reportedly be on a snap count until midseason (CBS Sports/Yahoo)

name: Jonathon Brooks
note: Out of practice 9/2-3/26 with unspecified soreness; coach Canales 'very optimistic' he plays Week 1; history of back-to-back ACL surgeries on right knee (ESPN/On3)

name: Chuba Hubbard
note: Hamstring strain from training camp, missed all preseason games, but hit 20+ mph in return-to-play drills and ahead of schedule; Panthers expect him ready for Week 1 as starter alongside Brooks (Fox Sports/NBC Sports)

name: Patrick Mahomes
note: Recovering from torn ACL/LCL that ended 2025 season; full practice since July clearance, no preseason game reps, but on track to start Week 1 vs Broncos 9/14 (Bleacher Report/CBS Sports)

name: Wan'Dale Robinson
note: Recovering from torn right ACL (Week 11 2025); now with Titans in 2026; limited on all Week 1 injury reports and considered doubtful for opener, targeting return 9/17 at Arizona (CBS Sports)

name: Jakobi Meyers
note: Hand injury from joint practice with Panthers, returned to practice ~9/3; coach Liam Coen says he's 'all good', not a Week 1 concern (RotoWire/Silver and Black Pride)

name: Kyle Monangai
note: Hyperextended right knee in practice, labeled week-to-week by coach Ben Johnson; Week 1 (9/13 vs Panthers) in doubt but avoided IR on roster cuts, expected back within first 4 weeks (ESPN/SI)

name: Rachaad White
note: Now with Commanders (signed 2026 FA deal); hamstring injury not considered serious, ruled out of 2nd preseason game but progressing; expected to handle change-of-pace/pass-down role behind Jacory Croskey-Merritt for Week 1 opener 9/13 vs Eagles (Pro Football Network)

name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
note: Lower-body/groin injury from 8/20 practice kept him out of final two preseason games; returned to practice 9/1, on track for Week 1 as favorite for early-down carries in Washington backfield (CBS Sports/RotoWire)

name: Josh Downs
note: Calf injury, missed practice Tue/Wed early Sept but called it 'very minor' and 'precautionary'; returned to practice, likely ready for Week 1 vs Ravens (Yahoo Sports/SI)

name: De'Zhaun Stribling
note: Rookie WR (49ers, Rd2/33rd overall 2026 draft out of Ole Miss); missed camp practice time with hamstring tightness, not a strain, considered minor setback (Yahoo Sports)

name: Khalil Shakir
note: High ankle sprain in camp; progressing well, no boot, tracking to be ready for Week 1 vs Texans per McDermott (9/2/26 report).

name: Zach Charbonnet
note: Torn ACL (Jan 2026, surgery 2/20/26); placed on reserve/PUP, out minimum 4 games, earliest return Week 5 vs SF (RotoWire/NFL.com, 9/2-9/3/26).

name: Isiah Pacheco
note: Placed on IR 9/1-9/2/26 with back injury/MCL sprain, out at least 4 games (earliest Week 5 vs ARI); GM only says 'that's the hope' he returns this season (ESPN/Detroit News, 9/2/26).

name: Alvin Kamara
note: MCL sprain suffered 8/18/26 joint practice, expected out ~1 month; HC Kellen Moore said Week 1 status undetermined as of early Sept, decision pending (CBS Sports).

name: Jalen McMillan
note: Recovering from knee/leg injury, back to practice on the side, Bowles says 'headed in the right direction'; no Week 1 ruling-out reported as of early Sept 2026, but injury-prone history is a lingering risk.

name: Kenyon Sadiq
note: Rookie TE (Jets) had hernia-surgery setback in camp, limited to side work through preseason, but HC Aaron Glenn said he's on track to play Week 1 vs Titans.

name: Jordyn Tyson
note: Rookie WR (Saints, No. 8 overall pick) hamstring injury 8/17/26, placed on IR w/ return designation 8/30/26; expected out ~2 months, likely beyond Week 5, recurring hamstring history flagged pre-draft.

name: Terrance Ferguson
note: Rookie TE (Rams) dealt with groin injury/soreness limiting him to one preseason game; no confirmed Week 1 game-status ruling found as of early Sept 2026, appears trending to play.

name: Keaton Mitchell
note: Missed 6 straight practices (undisclosed injury) but Chargers GM Joe Hortiz expects him to play Week 1 vs Cardinals (9/13/26); in rotation behind Omarion Hampton with Kimani Vidal.

name: Saquon Barkley
note: No confirmed new injury for Week 1 2026 found; listed as an Eagles team captain, participated in joint practices 8/20/26. Healthy per available data.

name: Derrick Henry
note: No injury designation; named a Ravens 2026 team captain, on track to open Week 1 vs Colts as the lead back.

name: Davante Adams
note: No fresh Sept 2026 injury news found; most recent issue was a hamstring strain during the 2025 playoffs, resolved. No Week 1 2026 concern reported.

name: Travis Kelce
note: Expected to play Week 1 (Mon 9/14/26 vs Broncos); missed a ceremonial kickoff luncheon due to illness, not an injury (CBS Sports/Yahoo).

name: Lamar Jackson
note: No active injury designation heading into Week 1 2026; named a Ravens team captain.

name: Joe Burrow
note: Fully cleared for camp per HC Zac Taylor (late July 2026); no injury concerns reported for Week 1 2026.

name: Justin Jefferson
note: Mild hamstring strain in late-July camp fully resolved; returned to practice and expected to start Week 1 vs Bears (CBS Sports, early Sept 2026).

name: CeeDee Lamb
note: No reported injury concerns heading into Week 1 2026; healthy after missing 3 games last season.
